items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron with a command

items.quote: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
items.claim: Command to conduct a census of Kohathites organized by family and household
items.mechanism: after their families, by the house of their fathers

items.quote: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
items.claim: Males aged 30-50 who enter the military host shall perform work in the tabernacle
items.actor: all that enter into the host
items.mechanism: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old
